architecture.bootstrap: Verified ResponseGenerator._generate wrapper runs inside stock _run_generate exception handler on actual _generation_thread. Cache policy precedes original default_stream/load_default/preload path.
architecture.fail_closed: Unsupported distribution version/install origin/file hash/module origin/method source or signature/API rejected; off-worker or unexpected provider binding rejected; policy failure stays inside stock worker failure handling.
architecture.policy: mx.set_cache_limit(0) disables free-buffer caching; allocation reclamation may occur on subsequent allocations. Not an active-memory/RAM/swap hard cap.
architecture.preload_scope: Only provider instance initial load_default temporarily wrapped; original bound method invoked exactly once; instance hook restored immediately on success/failure and if original worker fails before preload.
architecture.preserved: Official main() arguments verbatim, stock sampling/templates/tool parsing/generation/request queues/cache semantics/concurrency/HTTP/stop/join/signal/lifecycle. No network/server run during this implementation.
architecture.startup_observations: JSON stderr events before cache policy, policy applied before preload, startup preload completion/failure and worker finish. Active/cache/process-cumulative peak sampled only on actual worker; no reset_peak_memory or per-request hooks.

official_sources.semantics: Free-cache limit; zero disables cache; reclamation on next allocation. No active-memory-cap claim.
Active allocator bytes exclude cached buffers and differ from system memory.
